title: Features
text:
Master the fundamentals of NotebookLM and see how it transforms your daily workflow.






Introduction to NotebookLM







Ask questions about your documents in natural language and receive instant, precise, source-backed answers.






Chat Functions & Techniques







Transform complex documents into visual mindmaps that show key topics and connections at a glance.






Mindmap Creation







Convert any document into natural podcast-style conversations that you can listen to while commuting or multitasking.






Creating Audio Overviews







Automatically create quiz questions, glossaries, and self-review materials from your documents.






Creating Study Guides







Create professional briefing documents that summarize key topics, timelines, and decisions from multiple sources.






Creating Briefing Documents







Automatically create comprehensive FAQ sections from your documentation for customer service and training purposes.






FAQ Creation







Extract chronological information from documents to create clear timelines for projects, events, or processes.






Timeline Creation







Find and import relevant web sources directly into your notebook to expand your knowledge base.






Source Discovery







Create, organize, and manage your insights while building a comprehensive knowledge archive.






Notes Management







Upload YouTube videos, training materials, and multimedia content to extract transcripts and insights.






Processing Video Sources

If an audio overview already exists, it must be deleted first.

2 Under “Deep dive conversation,” select Customize.

Enter a custom prompt (max. 500 characters).
Example prompt (adjust placeholders):
Create an audio overview for [TARGET_AUDIENCE] 
with a [TONE] tone. 
Focus on [FOCUS] and aim for [DURATION]. 
Cover key insights with concrete examples.

PLACEHOLDERS

[TARGET_AUDIENCE] = Kärcher management
[TONE] = professional
[FOCUS] = practical insights  
[DURATION] = 8-10 min.

- Key insights to be drawn from this document

title: Departments
text:
Below you will find use case examples for different departments.
Regardless of your specific area, the general process remains the same:

Identify documents relevant to your department
Create a new notebook in NotebookLM
Upload the selected materials
Formulate prompts tailored to your team’s needs
Practice with real scenarios from your daily work



NotebookLM can support marketing professionals with campaign planning, brand positioning, and content analysis. Below you’ll find practical examples of how various marketing functions can benefit from public documents and strategic prompts.






Brand Management





Use NotebookLM to:

Analyze your brand’s language and tone of voice
Compare your positioning with that of competitors
Extract key statements or value propositions from a page

Suggested Document:

Kärcher About Us Page

Example Prompts:
What emotions or messages are emphasized on this page?
How is the brand positioned in terms of innovation and user-friendliness?









Campaign Management





Use NotebookLM to:

Summarize industry reports and identify campaign-relevant trends
Generate messaging ideas based on audience insights
Structure creative briefings based on strategic guidelines

Suggested Approach:
Use Gemini Deep Research to create a report. Upload this report to NotebookLM.
Example Prompts:
What are the top marketing trends mentioned in the report?
Which KPIs will become more important in 2025?






NotebookLM can help sales teams quickly grasp product materials, handle objections, and align their approach with customer needs. Use the following examples to explore NotebookLM for real sales tasks.






Direct Sales





Use NotebookLM to:

Extract key selling points from product brochures or websites
Prepare objection-handling arguments
Practice role-play dialogues based on FAQs or support cases

Suggested Documents:

Yellow Files
Kärcher T-RANGE Product Page
Internal sales cheat sheets (if available)

Example Prompts:
List five customer pain points that this product solves.
What are the strongest arguments for professional buyers?









Key Account Management





Use NotebookLM to:

Change speed, download your audio, or delete it

title: NotebookLM
text:
Customized Audio Overviews




If you have already created an audio overview, you must delete it first
1 Navigate to the “Audio Overview” section in the Studio area
2 Under “Deep Dive Conversation” select Customize
Enter a custom prompt (max. 500 characters)

Example prompt (adapt the placeholders)
Create an audio overview for [TARGET AUDIENCE] 
with a [TONE] tone. 
Focus on [FOCUS] and aim for [DURATION]. 
Address key insights with concrete examples.

PLACEHOLDERS

[TARGET AUDIENCE] = Kärcher management
[TONE] = professional
[FOCUS] = practical insights  
[DURATION] = 8-10 min.

title: Use Cases
text:
Choose one of the following use cases to practice:






Example Use Cases






A. Presentation Preparation: Transform reports into compelling presentation content.
B. Competitive Analysis: Analyze multiple competitor documents simultaneously
C. Training Accelerator: Transform manuals into engaging content
D. Precise Communication: Communicate precisely – clearly, understandably, and effectively.
E. Department-Specific Use Case: Explore specialized applications for your department







Challenge: Presentation due Friday
Goal: Transform reports into compelling presentation content.
What you need:

Real data/reports from your work
A new NotebookLM notebook

Steps:

Open NotebookLM
Select Create new
Upload your report or data documents
Use this prompt in the chat (replace target audience and length):







Prompt





Create a presentation outline with
- 5 compelling discussion points
- Supporting data for each point
- 3 key insights for executives
- 10 potential Q&A use cases

Target audience: "Board of directors"
Presentation length: "30 minutes"




Save the result as a Note
Create an Audio Summary to practice your presentation
Create a Mindmap for a visual overview





Challenge: Understanding the competitive landscape
Goal: Analyze multiple competitor materials simultaneously.
What you need:

Multiple competitor documents (reports, brochures, presentations)
A new NotebookLM notebook

Steps:

Open NotebookLM
Select Create new
Upload multiple competitor materials
Use this prompt in the chat:







Prompt





Compare these competitor documents and identify:
- Their main advantages
- Gaps in their offerings
- Opportunities for our company
- Price/positioning differences
Create a strategic summary.




Save the result as a Note
Ask follow-up questions about specific competitors
Create a Mindmap to visualize the competitive landscape





Challenge: Making technical content engaging
Goal: Transform technical manuals into engaging training content.
What you need:

Technical manuals or training materials
A new NotebookLM notebook

Steps:

Open NotebookLM
Select Create new
Upload your technical training materials
Use this prompt in the chat (replace the placeholder):







Prompt





Transform this technical manual into
- 10 practical use cases/examples
- Interactive Q&A for self-review
- Checklist with key points
- Common mistakes to avoid
Make it engaging for [TARGET AUDIENCE].

[TARGET AUDIENCE] = "Project managers"




Save the result as a Note
Create an Audio Summary for auditory learning
Ask for specific scenarios or case studies





Challenge: Perfecting professional communication
Goal: Communicate precisely – clearly, understandably, and effectively.
What you need:

Documents related to your communication topic
A new NotebookLM notebook

Steps:

Open NotebookLM
Select Create new
Upload relevant documents for context
Use this prompt in the chat (replace the placeholder):







Prompt





Write a [TEXT] based on these documents that:
- Clearly outlines the situation
- Provides necessary context
- Recommends specific actions
- Includes next steps and a timeline
The tone should be [TONE]

PLACEHOLDERS:
[TEXT] = "Email"
[TONE] = "friendly"
Examples for placeholders:
[TEXT] = “Email” or “Update” or “Proposal”, …
[TONE] = “professional” or “casual” or “urgent”, …




Save the result as a Note
